Name: Apex Radio
Description: Voice race engineer for Le Mans Ultimate: radio button, spotter, live race info, car commands that show their real state, and quick chat messages. Requires the free Apex Radio app.

com.apexradio.streamdeck.radio.Name: Radio (talk)
com.apexradio.streamdeck.radio.Tooltip: Hold to talk to your race engineer, like the radio button on your wheel.

com.apexradio.streamdeck.info.Name: Live info
com.apexradio.streamdeck.info.Tooltip: Shows position, fuel, gaps, box or lap time. Press: the engineer says it on the radio.

com.apexradio.streamdeck.spotter.Name: Spotter on/off
com.apexradio.streamdeck.spotter.Tooltip: Turns the spotter (car left / right) on or off.

com.apexradio.streamdeck.voice.Name: Radio on/off
com.apexradio.streamdeck.voice.Tooltip: Mutes or unmutes the race engineer.

com.apexradio.streamdeck.repeat.Name: Repeat
com.apexradio.streamdeck.repeat.Tooltip: The engineer repeats her last message.

com.apexradio.streamdeck.ask.Name: Question
com.apexradio.streamdeck.ask.Tooltip: Asks the engineer a question you write in the key settings.

com.apexradio.streamdeck.car.Name: Car command
com.apexradio.streamdeck.car.Tooltip: Lights, ignition, limiter, wipers, TC, ABS… Apex presses your own LMU key and the key shows the car's real state.

com.apexradio.streamdeck.chat.Name: Quick chat
com.apexradio.streamdeck.chat.Tooltip: Sends a ready-made message in the LMU chat.
